subject.title: feat: carry Featured state into Control

question: Should schema-v1 feeds and snapshots that lack `featured` preserve bundled curation, or may absence become authoritative false through a coordinated producer-first rollout?
rationale: Code inspection cannot determine the intended cross-repository rollout order, snapshot compatibility promise, or whether temporarily emptying the Featured shelf is acceptable.

options.title: Add an authority capability
options.body: Version or capability-gate Featured authority so legacy feeds and snapshots preserve bundled curation while capable feeds make omission authoritative.

options.title: Coordinate producer-first rollout
options.body: Deploy and verify the producer first, then invalidate or migrate legacy snapshots before landing the consumer authority change.

options.title: Accept immediate unfeature behavior
options.body: Intentionally treat every schema-v1 omission as false and accept that existing feeds or snapshots may temporarily empty the published Featured shelf.

recommendation.title: Add an authority capability
recommendation.body: Version or capability-gate Featured authority so legacy feeds and snapshots preserve bundled curation while capable feeds make omission authoritative.

likelyOwner.reason: Their adjacent official-plugin architecture history makes them the best available owner for the compatibility and rollout contract.
